name: Falcon 9 Block 5 | NROL-146
description: First batch of satellites for a reconnaissance satellite constellation built by SpaceX and Northrop Grumman for the National Reconnaissance Office to provide imaging and other reconnaissance capabilities.

landing.description: The Falcon 9 first stage B1071 has landed on ASDS OCISLY after its 16th flight.

timeline.label: Stage 1 LOX Load
timeline.description: Start of liquid oxygen loading in the first stage

timeline.label: Stage 2 LOX Load
timeline.description: Start of liquid oxygen loading in the second stage

timeline.label: Tank Press
timeline.description: Fuel tanks are pressurized to flight levels

timeline.label: Startup
timeline.description: The onboard computer takes control over the countdown and runs last checks

timeline.label: GO for Launch
timeline.description: Launch director verifies go for launch

timeline.label: Ignition

timeline.label: Liftoff

timeline.label: SES-1
timeline.description: First start of the second engine

timeline.label: Entry Burn Startup
timeline.description: Start of the atmospheric entry burn

timeline.label: Entry Burn Shutdown

timeline.label: Stage 1 Landing Burn
